description: Bitbake recipe snippet for building and packaging Boost C++ libraries within the OpenEmbedded build system, including configuration, dependencies, build options, and installation steps.

methods.name: python __anonymous ()
methods.description: Defines package list and file references for Boost libraries dynamically based on configuration.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the Boost build environment, including copying platform headers, setting up user configuration, and preparing for build.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Runs the Boost build system with specified options to compile the libraries.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled Boost libraries and creates symbolic links for static and shared libraries, also adjusts CMake files for correct paths.
